hundred_years_war.1.desc.en: In the year of [GetCurrentYear], tensions between the [GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] and the [GetCountry('FRA').GetLongName] have reached a breaking point. The longstanding disputes over territory and claims to the [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] throne have erupted into open hostilities, marking the beginning of the [ShowSituationName('hundred_years_war')].\n\nBoth nations are now preparing for a protracted conflict that will shape the destiny of [ShowSubContinentName('western_europe')]. The world watches as these two great powers prepare for their inevitable clash on the battlefield.
hundred_years_war.1.desc.uk: [GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] i [GetCountry('FRA').GetLongName] довго ворогували одна з одною, але в [GetCurrentYear] роцi напруження мiж двома державами досягло межi. Приводом для вiдкритого протистояння стали домагання на [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip|l]ий престол i давнi територiальнi суперечки. Так почалася #TOOLTIP:SITUATION,hundred_years_war,X #L Столiтня вiйна#!#!.\n\nТепер обидвi держави готуються до затяжного конфлiкту, який визначить долю #TOOLTIP:SUB_CONTINENT,western_europe,X #L Захiдної Європи#!#!. Увесь свiт спостерiгає за двома титанами, якi ось-ось вступлять у неминучу запеклу сутичку.

hundred_years_war.10.desc.en: We still do not agree with the [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective] position about who should rule [ShowRegionName('france_region')]. Our claims are strong, and our armies will clearly show our righteousness.
hundred_years_war.10.desc.uk: Ми як i ранiше не згоднi з #L [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective|l]им#! вибором наступного правителя #TOOLTIP:REGION,france_region,X #L Францiї#!#!. Ми впевненi у своїй правотi i зможемо довести її на полi бою.

hundred_years_war.100.desc.en: In a remarkable turn of events, the [GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] has emerged victorious in the long and bitter conflict known as the Hundred Years' War. The [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective] crown has been forced to acknowledge the [GetCountry('ENG').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] territorial claims and make substantial concessions. This victory has brought newfound prestige and influence to the [GetCountry('ENG').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] throne.\n\n[GetCountry('ENG').GetNameWithNoTooltip] now has the chance to establish a more substantial presence in [ShowRegionName('france_region')] and secure its territorial gains. The world watches to see how [GetCountry('ENG').GetNameWithNoTooltip] will wield its newfound power in the region.
hundred_years_war.100.desc.uk: [GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] — переможець у тривалому конфлiктi, що увiйшов в iсторiю пiд назвою «Столiтня вiйна». Така перемога стала результатом неймовiрного збiгу обставин. #L [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective|U]ка#! влада була змушена визнати територiальнi претензiї [GetCountry('ENG').Custom('CL_RP')] i пiти на серйознi поступки. Перемога пiдвищила престиж [GetCountry('ENG').Custom('CL_RP')] i посилила вплив цiєї держави.\n\nТепер у [GetCountry('ENG').Custom('CL_RP')] з'явився шанс змiцнити свою владу у #TOOLTIP:REGION,france_region,X #L Францiї#!#! i захистити нещодавно завойованi землi. The [GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] has been forced to recognize [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] territorial integrity and make substantial concessions. This triumph has greatly enhanced the prestige and influence of [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip] on the stage of [ShowContinentName('europe')].\n\n[target_char.GetName] has the chance to consolidate [target_char.GetHerHis] reclaimed territories, strengthen [target_char.GetHerHis] royal authority, and establish [target_char.GetHerselfHimself] as a preeminent power in the region.

[GetCountry('ENG').GetLongName] — ця держава тепер вимушено визнає територiальну цiлiснiсть [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip|l]ої сторони, а заодно йде на деякi серйознi поступки. hundred_years_war.1537.desc.en: For hundreds of years the armies of [GetCountry('ENG').GetName] and [GetCountry('FRA').GetName] clashed in battlefields across [ShowSubContinentName('western_europe')]. While at times it seemed the conflict would come to an end, no side managed to utterly eradicate the other. Now, hundreds of years later, even [target_character1.GetName] and [target_character2.GetName] have forgotten the original cause of the war. The brutality of the many wars between them is slowly fading from memory.

І хоча часом здавалося, що ще трохи — і війна закінчиться, щоразу це враження було оманливим: жодна сторона не змогла остаточно здолати іншу. Ніхто — навіть [target_character1.GetName] і [target_character2.GetName] — вже не пам'ятає, через що взагалі почався цей конфлікт. Жахи незліченних воєн поступово зникають із пам'яті.

hundred_years_war.219.historical_info.en: Normandy was once the cornerstone of the Anglo-Norman realm, ruled by English monarchs ever since William the Conqueror claimed the English throne from these very lands. Its strategic and economic importance made it a constant point of friction between England and France. Though reconquered by the French crown under Philip II in the early 13th century, the English never fully relinquished their claims. At the outbreak of the Hundred Years' War, these old grievances resurfaced, with English kings asserting their right not just to the French throne, but to territories long lost — Normandy foremost among them. The region's dual heritage placed it at the center of dynastic rivalry and made it a flashpoint in the conflict to come.

Початок Столiтньої вiйни рiзко загострив старi образи: англiйськi королi заявляли своє право не лише на французький престол, а й на давно втраченi землi — передусiм на Нормандiю. hundred_years_war.220.historical_info.en: Jacob van Artevelde, a wealthy merchant and brewer from Ghent, emerged as a political leader during the early stages of the Hundred Years' War. Flanders, though a vassal of the French crown, relied heavily on English wool to sustain its powerful textile economy. As tensions between France and England escalated, van Artevelde championed a pro-English stance, securing trade and internal autonomy while resisting direct French control. His leadership briefly stabilized Flemish cities, but his growing power made him a target. In 1345, he would be murdered by a mob in Ghent, accused of attempting to impose English rule too directly.

hundred_years_war_historical_info.en: The Hundred Years' War was a long and brutal conflict between England and France that lasted from 1337 to 1453. It started when the English king claimed the French crown, arguing his right through his mother's bloodline, while the French rejected this under their own laws. Both sides already had overlapping territories in France, which only fueled the fire. What followed was a prolonged, on-and-off war filled with battles, betrayals, and shifting alliances that dragged on for over a century and shifted the geopolitical landscape of all of Western Europe forever.
